audit.why: HARD at 8/10 is consistent with 41.11% over 883 Emerald+ games, the largest sample in my slice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stored level chart gave Olaf levels 2 and 3 and the first-item and two-item stages, and gave level 6 to Skill. Every one of those contradicts the prose sitting beside it.
audit.why: The content early block says outright "Levels 1-3 are your window", whys[1] calls level 2 the strongest early punish and whys[2] says Mel out-pokes a pre-6 Olaf. Meanwhile whys[4] describes Ragnarok taking the lane over at 6, and whys[5] and whys[6] both say "even". The chart was inverted against its own explanations, and the packet chart agrees with the prose, not with the stored chart.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Skill, Mel, Mel, Skill, Olaf, Skill, Skill. Level 6 is now Olaf, which is the only stage either layer describes as a takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer is Kled boilerplate. tldr said "His dash goes through your reflect" and dosFull[1] said "Spend W on his burst, not his dash", while dontsFull[0] warned about reflex-W on "his gap-closer". Olaf has no dash and no gap-closer. Separately, the content layer twice claimed Reckless Swing true damage "ignores your W shield".
audit.why: Olaf kit is Undertow (projectile axe), Tough It Out (shield and attack speed), Reckless Swing (325-range true damage) and Ragnarok. Nothing in it is a dash. The decisive interaction is Ragnarok: he becomes immune to disables while he keeps attacking, which blanks Solar Snare, Mel only hard CC. True damage means resistances do not reduce it - that is a statement about armour and MR, not about shields, so the shield claim was wrong on its own terms. Also unstated anywhere: Undertow is a projectile Rebuttal can reflect, and its 9s cooldown refunds entirely if Olaf collects the axe, so standing on the pickup is what actually keeps him axeless.
audit.corrected: All dash and gap-closer references removed. Ragnarok named as the matchup-defining cooldown at 100s with the immunity condition stated. The true-damage line now says armour and MR buy nothing, dropping the false shield claim. Undertow reflect and the axe-pickup reset added.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d said Rebuttal is "gone for twenty seconds", and the cooldown breakdown pointed at Undertow as matchup-defining.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s, never twenty. And Undertow is a poor thing to build the green-light system on because it resets on pickup - the cooldown that actually gates committing is Ragnarok at 100/90/80s.
audit.corrected: 38s stated, and the cooldown breakdown rebuilt around Ragnarok with Undertow reset behaviour noted underneath.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing recorded the Undertow cooldown-reset-on-pickup mechanic.
audit.why: It changes the core lane pattern: dodging the axe is only half the play, because he refunds the cooldown by walking over it. Standing on the axe is the part that costs him tempo.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[0] and to the cooldown breakdown.

notes: PACKET DEFECT: packet says games:null for olaf; MC_REAL_GAMES.mel.olaf is 883. Audited from the real figure. KIT FLAG MISFIRE: champ-data/_kits/olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding ("shuts off enemy dashes"), but Riot description for Undertow is damage, armour reduction and move speed reduction only - no grounding. Per the standing rule I trusted the description and wrote no grounding claim; it is moot for Mel anyway since she has no dash. TENSION LEFT FOR YOU: the corrected chart gives Mel two stages and Olaf one, which reads generous against a 41.11% win rate.
